name: Kate Walks from the Backyard into the Woods
description: Kate leaves the backyard of a large home and walks into the nearby woods. The well-kept lawn gives way to trees and undergrowth as she moves deeper into the forest.
related_events: Kate crosses the backyard into the nearby woods

name: Kate Sits in the Nursery Rocking Chair
description: Kate sits in a rocking chair, her eyes fixed on the arched window. The room around her is a fully furnished nursery—crib, changing table, baby swing—all in place. The space is still. There is no baby.
related_events: Kate sits in rocking chair while gazing out arched window
Revelation of empty nursery setting

name: Kate Takes Prescribed Medication
description: Kate opens a medicine chest and shakes a pill from a prescription bottle. She picks up a Dixie cup, fills it with water, and swallows the pill with the water.
related_events: Kate retrieves a pill from a prescription bottle
Kate swallows a pill with water

name: Esther Enters and Approves the Remodeled Nursery
description: Kate pushed the door open, and Esther stepped inside. The room, once a nursery, had been transformed into a little girl's bedroom, with a lacy white canopy bed piled high with stuffed animals beneath arched windows. Esther turned to Kate and John, smiled, and said, "It's perfect."
related_events: Esther enters the room after Kate opens the door
Esther expresses approval of the room

name: John's Car Drives Through the Gate and Crosses the Brook
description: John's car turns at the gate and enters the private community, driving down a secluded road that winds through the forest. The road crosses the little brook before continuing deeper into the community.
related_events: John's car turns onto the road to the private community
John's car crosses the little brook

name: Rate Hangs Curtains and Steps Back
description: Rate finishes hanging curtains over a beautiful picture window. She steps back to admire her work. The house feels quiet, lonely, and too big.
related_events: Rate hangs curtains over a beautiful picture window
Rate steps back to admire her work
House feels quiet, lonely, and too big after task completion

name: John Lights the Grill While Daniel Watches
description: A banner reading "WELCOME HOME, ESTHERII" hangs above the yard. John squirts lighter fluid onto the charcoal in the grill and strikes a match, igniting the coals. Daniel stands nearby, watching his father closely as the fire begins to crackle and grow.
related_events: John ignites charcoal grill with lighter fluid
Daniel observes his father preparing the grill

name: Kate Wakes from a Nightmare and Confronts Reality
description: Kate wakes suddenly, her breath ragged. She gets up and walks to the apartment door, closing it with a soft click. The room is dark and still. She looks down, places a hand on her belly, and exhales shakily. Slowly, she slides to the floor, wrapping her arms around herself as silent tears begin to fall.
related_events: Kate closes the apartment door after waking from nightmare
Kate realizes she is not pregnant
Kate slides to the floor and begins to cry

name: Kate Wakes from a Nightmare and Hurries to the Bathroom
description: Kate jolts awake, her breathing sharp and uneven. She glances at John beside her; he stirs slightly but doesn't open his eyes. Without a sound, she slips out of bed, her feet touching the floor softly. She moves quickly across the room and steps into the bathroom, closing the door gently behind her.
related_events: Kate wakes up suddenly from a nightmare
Kate quietly leaves the bed while John remains asleep
Kate hurries to the bathroom

name: John and Kate Arrive at St. Cabrini's
description: John's car pulls into the parking lot of St. Cabrini's Home for Girls, a pillared mansion with a large porch. Two nuns stand on the porch overseeing a group of young girls playing in the yard. John and Kate step out of the car. From a second-floor window, a shaky, handheld view follows their movements. Kate pauses, sensing something, and looks up toward the window. The curtains flutter slightly, but no one is visible.
related_events: John's car arrives at St. Cabrini's Home for Girls
Kate senses someone watching from a second floor window

name: Sister Judith Finds Yolanda in the Closet
description: Sister Judith walks down into a dark storage area, calling out for Yolanda. The space is cluttered with objects that cast deep shadows, offering many places to hide. She moves through the room, scanning the corners and peering behind stacked crates. Near the back wall, she notices a closet door slightly ajar. She steps toward it, reaches out, and pulls it open. Inside, a child’s bare feet dangle just above the floor. A small 'Travel Turtle' lies on the ground beneath them. A chair is tipped over nearby. Sister Judith recoils, her breath catching in her throat.
related_events: Sister Judith searches the storage area for Yolanda
Sister Judith discovers a child's body in a closet

name: Esther Observes the Neighborhood
description: Esther walks through Coleman's neighborhood, surrounded by forest, where large houses sit on manicured lawns. A postman moves from driveway to driveway, placing mail in boxes. A Hispanic nanny pushes a baby in a stroller along the sidewalk, the child quiet under a sunshade. Nearby, gardeners kneel in flower beds, trimming bushes and pulling weeds, their tools lined up beside freshly watered soil.
related_events: Esther observes daily life in Coleman's neighborhood
Gardeners tend to flowers in Coleman's neighborhood
Hispanic nanny pushes baby in stroller through neighborhood
Postman delivers mail in Coleman's neighborhood

name: Kate Shares Pictures and Reveals Jessie as an Angel
description: Kate sits on Max's bed and flips through a series of pictures, pausing to comment on the flowers and cards people have sent. She speaks softly about missing their baby, and says she's sorry if Max recently lost a child too. She adds that she thinks a baby would have been more fun. In the final picture, a family is shown with a baby angel watching over them. Kate tells Max that Jessie is that angel, and that she is with them every day. She leans forward and gently kisses Max on the forehead.
related_events: Kate shows Max pictures while discussing their lost baby
Kate reveals that Baby Jessie is an angel
Kate kisses Max on the forehead

name: Sister Abigail Leads Search of the Home for Yolanda
description: Sister Abigail gathered the nuns and lay assistants and began a search through the home. They entered the playroom, then moved to the art room and the chapel, checking each space carefully. From there, they proceeded to the classrooms, the laundry room, and the rest rooms. In each room, they found no sign of Yolanda.
related_events: Sister Abigail leads search for Yolanda
Search team checks playroom, art room, and chapel
Classrooms, laundry room, and rest rooms found empty

name: Housemother Finds Yolanda Missing During Morning Inspection
description: The girls, aged five to seven, finish dressing and making their beds. The Housemother moves through the room, checking each bed and inspecting the children one by one. She pauses at a bed that remains unmade, its sheets tangled and pillow untouched. Looking around, she realizes one of the girls is missing. She turns to the others and calls out, 'Where's Yolanda?'
related_events: Girls prepare for the day by making beds and getting dressed
Housemother inspects the girls' beds and readiness
Housemother discovers Yolanda's unmade bed and absence
Housemother calls out to find Yolanda's whereabouts

name: Older Girls Perform Evening Hygiene as Housemother Searches for Yolanda
description: The older girls are in the dormitory, brushing their teeth and washing up. The Housemother enters the room, looks around, and asks if anyone has seen Yolanda. No one responds, and the girls continue with their routine.
related_events: Older girls brush teeth and wash up
Housemother enters the room and inquires about Yolanda

name: Kate Sits by the Brook and Takes Out Her Journal
description: Kate walks to a peaceful brook and sits down beside it, gazing at the water as her thoughts settle. After a moment, she reaches into her coat pocket, pulls out a worn journal filled with handwritten pages, and opens it in her lap, resting her hands on its cover as she continues to reflect.
related_events: Kate sits by a peaceful brook lost in her thoughts
Kate retrieves a journal from her coat pocket

name: Kate Writes by the Brook
description: After a short walk, Kate sits beside a peaceful brook and pulls a journal from her coat pocket. The pages are filled with handwritten entries. She pauses for a moment, then begins to write.
related_events: Kate begins writing in her journal

name: Kate Tucks Max Into Bed
description: Kate tucks Max into bed. She tells him they will read a story, then it will be bedtime. Max nods in agreement.
related_events: Kate tucks Max into bed
Kate confirms bedtime after the story

name: Max Chooses a Story About a Baby
description: Max asks Kate to read him a story. He reaches for a book on his nightstand and hands it to her. The title reads, 'We Were Going To Have A Baby, But We Had An Angel Instead.' Kate looks at the book, her expression tightening for a moment. She pauses, then offers Max a sad smile before opening the book to begin reading.
related_events: Max requests a story from Kate
Max chooses a specific book about a lost baby
Kate reacts with internal discomfort to the book choice
Kate hesitates then smiles sadly before reading

name: Kate and John Enter Their Room
description: Kate and John walk down the hallway with their arms around each other. They reach their room, step inside, and close the door behind them. The hallway falls dark and silent. The camera moves slowly back down the corridor toward Esther's room, focusing on the doorknob. After a moment, the sound of the lock clicking shut echoes from inside.
related_events: Kate and John walk to their room with arms around each other
Kate and John close their room door

name: The Lock Clicks Shut on Esther's Room
description: After Kate and John enter their room and close the door, the hallway falls dark and empty. The camera moves slowly down the hall toward Esther's room, coming to rest on the doorknob. A moment passes in silence, then the sound of the lock clicking echoes clearly into the stillness.
related_events: Lock of Esther's room clicks shut

name: Kate Teaches Esther to Sign Her Name
description: Kate sits with Esther, showing her how to sign her name in sign language. Esther says each letter aloud as she makes the corresponding sign: E-S-T. When she reaches 'T', Kate gently corrects her, guiding her hand into the right position. Esther notices the mistake and tries again, forming the letters E-S-T-H-E-R correctly. She practices the full sequence several times. Outside, the leaves have changed color, and Esther looks out the window in quiet wonder. She turns to Kate and says, 'It's so beautiful, motta.' Kate smiles and replies, 'Sweetie, here we say “Mont” or “mommy.”' Kate and John share a warm glance.
related_events: Kate teaches Esther sign language for her name
Esther practices signing her name correctly

name: Kate Corrects Esther's Word for Mommy
description: Esther gazes out at the colorful autumn leaves, marveling at their beauty. 'It's so beautiful, motta,' she says. Kate gently responds, 'Sweetie, here we say "Mont" or "mommy."' Esther listens quietly. Kate and John exchange a warm look.
related_events: Esther expresses admiration for the autumn leaves
Kate corrects Esther's pronunciation of 'mommy'
Kate and John share a warm look

name: Petting Hodgepodge with Care
description: Esther kneels in front of Hodgepodge's cage and asks if she can pet him. Kate agrees, but tells her she must promise not to let him out unless a parent is there to hold him, because he is delicate and could be hurt. Esther nods. Kate opens the cage, lifts Hodgepodge out, and kneels between Esther and Max. She holds the hamster as both children reach out and gently stroke his fur.
related_events: Esther asks to pet Hodgepodge
Kate explains rules for handling Hodgepodge
Kate lifts Hodgepodge from his cage
Kate kneels between Esther and Max to facilitate interaction with Hodgepodge
Esther and Max gently stroke Hodgepodge's fur

name: Esther Kneels to Observe Hodgepodge
description: Esther kneels in front of Hodgepodge's cage, looking at him closely.
related_events: Esther kneels to observe Hodgepodge in his cage

name: Kate Reacts to the Ringing Phone
description: Kate stops drying her hair when she hears the phone ring. She opens the bathroom door and steps into the doorway, watching as John reaches for the phone. Her face shows a look of dread as she stands there, silent and still, before he answers.
related_events: Kate stops drying her hair upon hearing the phone ring
Kate opens the bathroom door and observes John approaching the phone
Kate experiences dread before the phone call is answered

name: John Answers the Phone
description: The phone rings from off-screen. John reaches for it and picks it up. He says, 'Bello?' as he begins speaking.
related_events: John answers the ringing phone from off-screen

name: John and Kate on the Drive
description: John drives while Kate sits beside him, flipping through pages of photocopied records in a manila folder. He glances at her with an amused look. She looks up and asks if he’s not worried about being prepared. John tells her there’s not going to be a pop quiz. Kate smiles, closes the folder, and looks at the Polaroid of a seven-year-old Puerto Rican girl stapled to the cover. The name next to the photo is YOLANDA.
related_events: John drives while Kate reviews photocopied records
John gives Kate an amused look
Kate questions John about preparedness
John reassures Kate there will be no pop quiz
Kate smiles and closes the folder

name: Kate looks at Yolanda's photo
description: Kate closes the folder and looks at a Polaroid of a seven-year-old Puerto Rican girl named Yolanda, which is stapled to the cover.
related_events: Kate looks at a Polaroid of a young girl named Yolanda

name: Esther Stops to Watch Tropical Fish at the Pet Store
description: While walking through the mall with Kate and Max, Esther notices a pet store and slows down, falling behind the group. She approaches the store's display and presses her nose to the glass of an aquarium. Inside, tropical fish swim under a black light, their colors glowing vividly. She watches them silently, absorbed in the sight.
related_events: Esther becomes distracted by a pet store while walking through the mall
Esther gazes at tropical fish in a black-lit aquarium

name: Kate Suggests Showing Esther Hodgepodge at Home
description: After noticing Esther's fascination with the tropical fish in the pet store, Kate taps Max on the shoulder and signs to her, suggesting she show Esther their pet Hodgepodge when they return home. Max nods eagerly in response. Esther, seeing their exchange, looks at them with curiosity and asks, 'Hodgepodge? What's that?'
related_events: Kate suggests Max show Esther Hodgepodge at home
Esther expresses curiosity about Hodgepodge

name: Esther Helps Clean the Sanctuary
description: Esther works alongside a nun, cleaning the sanctuary. At one point, she looks up, notices Kate and John sitting in a pew near the back of the chapel, and waves at them. Kate and John wave back. Esther returns to her task, continuing to help with the cleaning.
related_events: Esther helps a nun clean the sanctuary
Esther waves at Kate and John
Kate and John wave back at Esther

name: Kate and John in the Chapel with Esther
description: Esther helps a nun clean the sanctuary, pausing briefly to wave at Kate and John, who sit in a pew near the back of the empty chapel. They wave back. Kate turns to John and says, "She really did open up with us, didn't she?" John replies, "She latched right onto you. We're probably the best chance she has at a normal life." Kate looks at him and says softly, "A normal life... That sounds really good, doesn't it?" She smiles and takes John's hand.
related_events: Kate expresses hope for Esther's normal life
John states Esther has latched onto Kate
Kate takes John's hand

name: Kate stops at intersection and watches pregnant woman
description: Kate stops her car at an intersection. A pregnant woman crosses the street and comes to a stop at the corner. Kate stares at her, motionless, her gaze fixed. In the backseat, Max claps her hands to get Kate's attention. Kate turns and sees Max pointing at the traffic light, which has turned green. A car behind them honks. Kate snaps out of it and drives forward.
related_events: Kate stops car at intersection
Pregnant woman crosses street and stops at corner
Kate stares at pregnant woman transfixed

name: Max Alerts Kate to the Green Light
description: Kate sits at the intersection, motionless, her eyes fixed on a pregnant woman who has stepped onto the curb. In the backseat, Max claps her hands sharply. When Kate doesn’t respond, Max points toward the traffic light. The light is green. A car behind them honks loudly. Kate jerks her head, breaks her stare, and drives forward.
related_events: Max claps hands to get Kate's attention
Max points to green traffic light
Car horn honks at stopped vehicle
Kate snaps out of daze and resumes driving

name: Kate Picks Up Max After School
description: Kate pulls up in her minivan as the school day ends at the deaf education program. Max, her five-year-old daughter, runs over to greet her. Kate kisses Max’s head and helps her into the car, fastening her seatbelt. Max holds up an art project she made in class and signs that her teacher helped. Kate nods, smiling, as they prepare to drive home.
related_events: Kate arrives in a luxury minivan to pick up her daughter Max
Max runs to greet her mother Kate
Kate kisses Max's head and helps her into the car
Max shows Kate her art project from school
Max signs that her teacher helped with the art project
related_occasions: School Dismissal At A Deaf Education Program

name: Parents Arrive to Pick Up Children After Class
description: Class has just ended, and parents begin arriving at the playground to collect their children. The playground is mostly silent, with children and teachers communicating through sign language. One by one, families reunite, exchanging smiles and signed greetings as they prepare to leave together.
related_events: Parents arrive to pick up their children after class
related_occasions: School Dismissal At A Deaf Education Program

name: Sister Abigail Walks Kate and John to the Door
description: Sister Abigail walks Kate and John to the front door. She tells them the notary will arrive at ten for them to sign the placement agreement. Kate thanks her and gives her a warm hug. As they embrace, Kate notices Esther standing at the end of the hallway, peering around a corner. Abigail and John see her too. Kate asks what Esther said earlier, recalling the word 'motta.' Sister Abigail explains it is Russian for 'mother.'
related_events: Sister Abigail escorts Kate and John to the front door
Sister Abigail informs Kate and John about the notary's arrival

name: Kate Hugs Sister Abigail and Notices Esther Watching
description: Kate hugged Sister Abigail, thanking her warmly. Midway through the embrace, she spotted Esther standing at the end of the hallway, peering around the corner. Sister Abigail and John turned and saw her too. The moment grew quiet as all three looked toward the girl, who remained still and silent in the distance.
related_events: Kate hugs Sister Abigail in gratitude
Kate notices Esther watching from the hallway
Sister Abigail and John notice Esther in the hallway

name: Kate Asks About Esther's Whisper
description: Kate, unsettled by what she heard, turns to Sister Abigail and asks about the word 'motta' that Esther had whispered. Sister Abigail replies that it is Russian for 'mother.' The word hangs in the air as Kate, John, and Sister Abigail stand silently, the meaning settling over them.
related_events: Kate asks about Esther's whispered word
Sister Abigail translates 'motta' as 'mother' in Russian

name: Kate Tries to Compose While Max Plays Basketball
description: Kate sits at the baby grand piano, playing a few notes, then erasing what she has written. She pauses, looking over at an orchid in an ornate planter by the window. Outside, Max dribbles a basketball in the driveway, but the ball is too big and the hoop too high. Each time she shoots, the ball falls short and bangs against the house. Kate opens the door and signs sharply, 'Stop banging that against the house! I'm trying to work!' Max signs back, 'Sorry,' with an abashed look. Kate sighs and signs, 'No, I'm sorry. But just... take a break for a little while, okay?' Max nods, and Kate returns inside.
related_events: Kate attempts to compose music at the piano
Max plays basketball in the driveway
Kate confronts Max about the noise
Max responds with an apology and abashed look
Kate apologizes to Max for her harsh tone

name: John and Daniel Return Home
description: A car pulls into the driveway, and John steps out with eleven-year-old Daniel, who is still in his Little League uniform. Daniel runs toward Max, grabs her basketball, and dribbles it around her in circles. He holds the ball out as if to give it to her, but snatches it away when she reaches for it, then shoots a lay-up. 'Boo yah! He shoots! He scores!' John calls out, 'Nice one, champ!' Daniel pumps his arm and sprints into the house, slamming the door behind him. He runs upstairs, footsteps echoing loudly. John picks up the basketball and hands it back to Max. He lifts her up to the hoop, and she drops the ball through the net. 'All right! Gimme five!' She smiles and gives him a high-five as he carries her inside. Back in the music room, Kate has just sat down at the piano when she hears Daniel burst into the house and race upstairs. She slumps her shoulders and closes her notebook.
related_events: Daniel arrives home with John and teases Max with the basketball
John encourages Daniel and interacts playfully with Max
Daniel runs into the house and upstairs noisily

name: Kate Stops Composing and John Brings Flowers
description: Kate sits back down at the piano after sending Max away for a break, but as soon as Daniel bursts into the house and runs upstairs, she slumps in her seat and closes her notebook. She gets up just as John walks into the music room. He tells her the curtains look nice. She corrects him, saying they’re curtains, not drapes, and remarks on how exciting her life must be now that she knows the difference. John hands her a bouquet of flowers. She asks what they’re for. He says, 'Just love you,' and kisses her. She takes the flowers, and some of the heaviness in her mood eases.
related_events: Kate abandons her music composition due to renewed distraction
John presents Kate with flowers and shares a kiss

name: Tucking Esther Into Bed
description: Esther lies in bed wearing a nightgown. Kate and John pull the covers up around her, smoothing them gently. Esther says, "I love you, motta -- I mean, Monmiy." Kate replies, "I love you, too, sweetie," and kisses her on the forehead. John leans in, and Esther wraps her arms tightly around him. They turn off the light and close the door. Esther watches them leave, her eyes following until the door shuts behind them.
related_events: Kate and John tuck Esther into bed

name: Esther and Kate Exchange Goodnight Words
description: Esther lies in bed in her nightgown as Kate and John tuck her in. Esther says, 'I love you, motta -- I mean, Monmiy,' stumbling over Kate's name. Kate smiles and replies, 'I love you, too, sweetie,' then kisses Esther on the forehead. John leans in to kiss her, and Esther hugs him tightly. They turn off the light and close the door, leaving Esther watching them as they leave.
related_events: Esther says 'I love you' to Kate, misspeaking the name
Kate responds with 'I love you' and kisses Esther on the forehead

name: Esther Hugs John, Lights Out
description: John leans in for a kiss and Esther hugs him tightly. Kate and John turn off the light and close the door.
related_events: Esther hugs John tightly as he leans in for a kiss
Kate and John turn off the light and close the door

name: Esther Watches Kate and John Leave
description: After Kate and John tuck Esther into bed, she stays awake as they turn off the light and close the door behind them. Lying in her nightgown, she watches them leave the room.
related_events: Esther watches Kate and John leave the room

name: John Whistles, Kate Sings Along
description: John whistles 'Whatever Will Be, Will Be' as he drives. Kate glances at him with an amused expression and playfully sings a modified version of the lyrics, teasing him. The two share a light moment, her voice blending with his whistling in a brief, easy exchange.
related_events: John whistles song while driving
Kate gives amused look at John
Kate jokingly sings along to whistled tune

name: John Reflects on the Girl's Strength
description: John whistles 'Whatever Will Be, Will Be' as he drives, and Kate gives him an amused look before jokingly singing a playful variation of the lyrics. She teases him about the impression the girl made on him. John says he wishes she had heard what the girl was saying before she arrived, adding that he knows adults who aren’t as mature. He pauses, then wonders aloud why they weren’t shown the girl’s case file. Kate suggests the girl probably wasn’t there when they first came looking. John says it amazes him that a kid could go through so much and still turn out the way she did. Kate gives him a look and says he sounds like they should be adopting her instead of Yolanda. John quickly assures her that’s not what he meant, and adds that he wouldn’t trade their little girl for anything. Kate smiles at him and squeezes his hand.
related_events: John expresses regret about conversation interruption
John questions absence of case file
Kate suggests timing explains lack of prior encounter
John expresses admiration for child's resilience

name: Kate Teases John, John Reaffirms Love for Their Daughter
description: Kate gives John an amused look and jokingly sings a playful variation of the song he’s whistling, teasing him about the impression a certain child has made on him. John responds by saying he hopes the girl gets a better break in life, then notices Kate’s expression and quickly adds that he wouldn’t trade their little girl for the world. Kate smiles at him warmly, reaches over, and squeezes his hand.
related_events: Kate teases John about adoption preference
John reassures Kate about their daughter
Kate gives adoring look and squeezes John's hand

name: John and Kate Lead Esther to the Surprise
description: John walks behind Esther with his hands over her eyes. Kate holds Esther's hand and guides her into a darkened room. Esther stands still, her eyes covered, as they position her in the space. John removes his hands from her eyes.
related_events: John covers Esther's eyes and walks behind her
Kate leads Esther into a darkened room by the hand

name: John Reveals the Fish Tank to Esther
description: John removes his hands from over Esther's eyes. She blinks and stops suddenly, staring at the fish tank from the shopping mall now placed in the room. Her face fills with awe. She kneels in front of it, turns the black light on and off, watching how it makes her dress glow and the colors in her paintings brighten. She looks up and gives Kate and John a wide smile.
related_events: John uncovers Esther's eyes
Esther reacts with awe upon seeing the fish tank

name: Esther Discovers the Black Light
description: Esther kneels before the fish tank and reaches for the black light. She turns it on, then off, watching as the colors in her dress and the paintings around her shift and glow. Her face lights up with a smile as she repeats the action, fascinated by the changing light.
related_events: Esther turns the black light on and off to observe glowing effects

name: Esther Smiles in Appreciation
description: After turning the black light on and off and watching the colors in her paintings glow, Esther turns to Kate and John and gives them a big smile.
related_events: Esther smiles at Kate and John in appreciation

name: Arrival and Reunion with Max
description: The car pulls into the driveway and the family gets out. Max runs out from the house and rushes toward them. Kate opens her arms and pulls Max into a tight hug, kissing him and telling him how much they missed him. The group stands together near the car, beginning to reconnect as they prepare to go inside.
related_events: Family arrives at the house and is greeted by Max
Kate hugs and kisses Max upon arrival

name: Esther Greets Max in Sign Language
description: Esther steps forward and signs to Max without speaking: HELLO, MAX. MY NAME IS ESTHER. Max's face lights up with excitement, and he turns to Kate, smiling broadly.
related_events: Esther signs her name to Max and greets him silently
Max reacts with excitement to Esther's sign language greeting

name: Daniel Reacts to Esther's Arrival
description: They pull into the driveway and get out. Esther's mouth practically hangs open at the sight of the beautiful house. The front door opens and Max runs out to meet them. Daniel appears in the doorway with Doris Coleman, their grandmother. When Daniel sees Esther—a pale girl with Goldilocks curls and a frilly white dress—he stands frozen, then mutters, 'Holy shit...' under his breath. Max runs into Kate's arms, receiving a big hug and a kiss. Kate says they missed him so much. She turns to Esther and smiles. Max hangs back, a little shy. Esther signs silently: 'HELLO, MAX. MY NAME IS ESTHER.' Max grins excitedly at Kate. 'She's been practicing the whole way,' Kate says. She takes the girls' hands, and they walk up to the house. Along the way, Esther notices Max's hearing aid.
related_events: Daniel sees Esther for the first time and reacts with shock

name: Walking to the House and Noticing the Hearing Aid
description: Kate took the girls' hands and led them up the driveway toward the house. As they walked, Esther looked at Max and noticed the hearing aid in his ear.
related_events: Kate leads the group toward the house holding the girls' hands
Esther notices Max's hearing aid

name: John Introduces Esther to Doris
description: John brings Esther over to meet Grandma Doris. 'Esther, this is Grandma Doris,' he says. Doris smiles and responds, 'It's a pleasure to meet you, too.'
related_events: John introduces Esther to Grandma Doris
Doris expresses pleasure in meeting Esther

name: Esther's Curtsey Surprises the Group
description: When introduced to Doris, Esther responds with a perfect little curtsey. The gesture catches everyone off guard. Daniel lets out a laugh but quickly stops when Kate gives him a sharp look.
related_events: Esther surprises others with a perfect little curtsey
Daniel fails to suppress a laugh at Esther's curtsey
Kate silences Daniel with a look

name: Daniel Meets Esther
description: Jun introduces Daniel as their son to Esther. Esther smiles and extends her hand in greeting. Daniel hesitates, then reluctantly shakes her hand.
related_events: Jun introduces Daniel as their son to Esther
Esther offers her hand to Daniel in greeting
Daniel grudgingly shakes Esther's hand

name: John Kisses Doris on the Cheek
description: John greets Doris with a kiss on the cheek.
related_events: John gives Doris a kiss on the cheek

name: Esther Explores Her New Home
description: Esther walks from room to room, marveling at the size of her new home. The family follows behind her. She continues to the next room, while Daniel lags back and whispers to John, 'Why is she dressed like that?' John replies, 'Don't be rude.' Esther hears them but pretends she does not. Kate notices and tries to distract her by asking if she would like to see her room. Esther smiles and nods. As they start up the stairs, she glances furtively at Daniel, watching him.
related_events: Esther tours her luxurious new home in awe

name: Daniel's Whisper About Esther's Clothes
description: Esther walks from room to room, marveling at the size of her new home, while Kate and the others follow behind. As she moves into the next room, Daniel hangs back and turns to John, whispering—just loud enough to be heard—'Why is she dressed like that?' John responds quietly, 'Don't be rude.' Esther pauses slightly, then continues walking, her expression unchanged, though she does not look back. Kate notices and quickly asks Esther if she would like to see her room. Esther smiles and nods. As they start up the stairs, she glances sideways at Daniel, watching him from the corner of her eye.
related_events: Daniel comments critically on Esther's clothing
John tells Daniel not to be rude
Esther overhears the comment but pretends not to notice

name: Kate Shows Esther to Her Room
description: Kate turns to Esther and asks if she would like to see her room. Esther smiles and nods eagerly. The group begins to move toward the stairs, leaving the previous moment behind.
related_events: Kate attempts to distract Esther
Esther agrees to see her room with enthusiasm

name: Esther Glances at Daniel on the Stairs

name: Therapy Session: Talking About the Anniversary and Staying Sober
description: Water trickles in a small Zen fountain as Kate sits across from Dr. Browning, a mousy-haired woman in her fifties. Dr. Browning mentions that many women feel emotional around the anniversary of a miscarriage or the baby’s expected due date, and says it’s completely normal. Kate says she’s been thinking about going back to work and thought she was doing better. Dr. Browning tells her she’s making progress and encourages her to reflect on how far she’s come in four months. She then asks directly if Kate is still sober. Kate hesitates, then admits she drove by the wine shop on her way home the other day. She didn’t go in, but she wanted to. She says the idea of buying a bottle was just in case they had guests. Dr. Browning asks if she went inside. Kate says no. Dr. Browning affirms that not going in matters, and urges her to focus on that. She reminds Kate that grief moves at its own pace and suggests she keep writing in her journal. Kate gives a weak smile, not fully convinced.

Sister Abigail explains that Esther’s birth mother died of AIDS and the American family who adopted her later perished in a house fire. She says Esther is emotionally distant, rarely speaks, and doesn’t play with the other children. Sister Abigail adds that she suspects Esther has been sexually abused, though there is no record of it. She notes that Esther shows signs of deep trauma—she avoids showering with the other girls, won’t let anyone in the bathroom with her, and is unusually fixated on her appearance, wearing dresses and ribbons every day. When the ribbons were once removed, Esther reacted violently, kicking out two of Sister Francis’ teeth. She responds stiffly, trying to get into the moment, as he slides a hand around her waist and moves it up to her breast. Kate pulls away and says, 'I'm sorry. I can't. Shit.' Tears well in her eyes. John stops, giving her space, and watches with concern as she turns from him.

name: Kate Breaks Down Over Emotional Struggles
description: Kate sits on the bed after rubbing lotion on her feet, her expression tense as John reaches out to touch her. He runs his fingers up her back, moves closer, and kisses her neck. She responds stiffly, then pulls away, tears in her eyes. 'I'm sorry. I can't,' she says, wiping her face. John watches, concerned, giving her space. 'I'm so sick of feeling like this,' she says. 'The kids must think I'm crazy.' She tells him about seeing a pregnant woman on the way home and nearly breaking down in front of Max. 'Daniel barely talks to me. You and I haven't had sex in over a year. What if I never get better? I don't want to lose you.' John reassures her, 'You're never going to lose us.' He asks if she's thought more about adopting. She says she can't even handle being a mother to their current children. John insists the kids understand, that they just know she's not happy. 'But I should be,' she says. He asks if she wants another child. 'Yes,' she says. He points out they still want a child, even if not biologically theirs. 'We can't replace our baby,' he says, 'but we can give a home to a child who needs one.' Kate looks at him, then smiles through her tears.

Kate reveals prolonged absence of intimacy in relationship

name: John Reassures Kate About the Kids and Her Worries
description: Kate wipes her eyes and looks at John, her voice shaky as she talks about how the children must see her—as unstable, as broken. John reaches for her, his hand resting gently on her arm. He tells her to stop worrying about what everyone thinks, his voice firm but kind. She says the kids must think she's crazy, but John shakes his head. He says they understand, that they just know she's not happy. Kate insists she should be happy, but John doesn't argue. He looks at her, steady and calm, and reminds her they’re still a family, that she’s not losing them. His words hang in the air as she studies his face, the weight of them slowly settling in.

John challenges Kate's self-perception and affirms children's understanding

name: John and Kate Discuss Adopting a Child

John reassures her that she won’t lose him or the children, urging her to stop worrying about what others think. When Kate mentions seeing a pregnant woman and nearly breaking down, John brings up adoption again. Kate resists, saying she can’t even care properly for the children they have, and that adopting shouldn’t be a solution to loneliness or grief. John counters that they’ve always wanted another child and that their love and home can still offer something meaningful to a child in need. He reminds her they’re good parents and that being a family makes them happy. After a pause, Kate looks at him, then softly smiles through her tears.

name: John Tells Kate About the Funeral and the Choking Game
description: John stands by the open sliding glass door of the hotel room as Kate smokes a cigarette, staring out at the parking lot. He tells her that the birth family is claiming the girl's body and planning a private funeral. He adds that Sister Abigail believes the girl may have died while playing something called the 'choking game,' a dangerous schoolyard activity where children choke themselves for a rush, sometimes accidentally going too far. Kate looks at him, her voice flat, and asks if the girl is just going to vanish from their lives. John suggests they hold their own service, but Kate cuts him off, saying she’s been in grief counseling for nearly a year and a half and won’t tolerate talk of closure. John falls silent. After a pause, Kate says maybe they weren’t meant to do this. John disagrees. She reminds him of her miscarriage and how it left her unable to have children, then says now the girl they were adopting has died the night before they were to bring her home. John insists the girl’s death wasn’t a message and that they didn’t cause it. Kate says she can’t go through it again. John proposes adopting Esther instead. Kate turns to him, cool and measured, and asks if he’s already trying to replace the girl. John says they can’t replace her, but Esther is alive and needs them now. Kate hesitates, then says they should find out what Sister Abigail thinks.

He mentions Sister Abigail’s belief that Yolanda may have died playing the choking game, a dangerous schoolyard act. Kate responds flatly, asking if Yolanda is just going to vanish from their lives. name: Kate and John Debate Whether to Keep Trying to Build a Family
description: Kate stands by the window, staring at the parking lot, her cigarette burning down between her fingers. John tells her that Yolanda’s birth family is claiming her body and planning a private service. He mentions that Sister Abigail believes Yolanda may have died from playing the choking game, a dangerous act some children do for a rush. Kate asks if that means Yolanda just vanishes from their lives. John suggests they hold their own service, but Kate cuts him off, saying she’s been in grief counseling for nearly a year and a half and will react violently if he mentions closure. She says maybe they aren’t meant to do this—have a family. John disagrees strongly. Kate reminds him of her miscarriage in the third trimester, which left her unable to have children, and now Yolanda’s death the night before they were to bring her home. She asks if that isn’t a sign. John insists Yolanda’s death wasn’t a lesson and they didn’t cause it. Kate says it doesn’t matter—she can’t go through it again. John then suggests adopting Esther. Kate turns to him, cold and surprised, asking if he’s already trying to replace Yolanda. John says they can’t replace Yolanda, just like they can’t replace Jessie, but Esther is alive and needs them now. Kate hesitates, then says they should wait.
